info.title: Gerrit Code Review REST API
info.description: The Gerrit Code Review REST API. Paths, parameters, and payload schemas are generated statically from the server's REST bindings; human-authored summaries and descriptions are supplied here and merged in at build time.

get.description: Queries changes visible to the caller. The query is given by the repeatable query parameter; use limit/start to page and o to request extra fields.

post.description: Creates a new change from a ChangeInput entity.

example.subject: Let's support 100% Gerrit workflow direct in browser
Let's support 100% Gerrit workflow direct in browser

get.description: Retrieves a single change as a ChangeInfo entity; request additional data with the o parameter.

post.description: Abandons a change; an optional message is posted as a change message.

get.description: Returns all users that are currently in the attention set. As response a list of AttentionSetInfo entity is returned.

post.description: Adds a single user to the attention set of a change.
Deletes a single user from the attention set of a change.

get.description: Performs consistency checks on the change, and returns a ChangeInfo entity with the problems field set to a list of ProblemInfo entities.

post.description: Performs consistency checks on the change as with GET /check, and additionally fixes any problems that can be fixed automatically. The returned field values reflect any fixes.
Tests a submit requirement and returns the result as a SubmitRequirementResultInfo.

get.description: Lists the published comments of all revisions of a change, grouped by file path.
Gets the custom keyed values associated with a change.

post.description: Adds and/or removes custom keyed values from a change.

get.description: Retrieves a change with labels, detailed labels, detailed accounts, reviewer updates, and messages.

200.description: The change as a ChangeInfo entity, with the detail fields populated.

get.description: Lists the draft comments of all revisions of the change that belong to the calling user.
Retrieves the change edit of the calling user, if one exists, as an EditInfo entity.

post.summary: Restore file content or rename files in Change Edit
post.description: Creates empty change edit, restores file content or renames files in change edit. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditInput entity when a file within change edit should be restored or old and new file names to rename a file.

get.summary: Retrieve file content from Change Edit
get.description: Retrieves content of a file from a change edit.

put.summary: Change file content in Change Edit
put.description: Put content of a file to a change edit.

delete.description: Deletes a file from a change edit. This deletes the file from the repository completely. This is not the same as reverting or restoring a file to its previous contents.

get.summary: Retrieve meta data of a file from Change Edit
get.description: Retrieves meta data of a file from a change edit. Currently only web links are returned.

put.summary: Change author or committer identity in Change Edit
put.description: Modify author or committer identity. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditIdentityInput entity. Either name or email must be provided. type must be either AUTHOR or COMMITTER.

get.summary: Retrieve commit message from Change Edit or current patch set of the change
get.description: Retrieves commit message from change edit.

put.summary: Change commit message in Change Edit
put.description: Modify commit message. The request body needs to include a ChangeEditMessageInput entity.

post.description: Promotes change edit to a regular patch set.
Rebases change edit on top of latest patch set.

get.description: Gets the hashtags associated with a change.

post.description: Adds and/or removes hashtags from a change.

get.description: Retrieves the branches and tags in which a change is included. As result an IncludedInInfo entity is returned.

post.description: Adds or updates the change in the secondary index.

post.summary: Create Merge Patch Set For Change
post.description: Update an existing change by using a MergePatchSetInput entity.

get.description: Returns the commit message of the change (from the current patch set).

put.description: Creates a new patch set with a new commit message.

get.description: Lists the messages of a change as ChangeMessageInfo entities.

get.description: As response a ChangeMessageInfo entity is returned.

post.description: Deletes a change message by replacing the change message with a new message, which contains the name of the user who deleted the change message and the reason why it was deleted. The reason can be provided in the request body as a DeleteChangeMessageInput entity.

get.description: Retrieves the difference between two historical states of a change by specifying the old=SHA-1 and the meta=SHA-1 parameters.

post.description: Moves a change to another branch, given by a MoveInput entity.
Creates a new patch set on a destination change from the provided patch.
Marks the change to be private. Only open changes can be marked private. Changes may only be marked private by the owner or site administrators.

delete.description: Marks the change to be non-private. Note users can only unmark own private changes.

post.description: Marks the change to be non-private. Note users can only unmark own private changes.

get.description: Check if the given change is a pure revert of the change it references in revertOf. Optionally, the query parameter o can be passed in to specify a commit (SHA-1 in 40 digit hex representation) to check against. It takes precedence over revertOf. If the change has no reference in revertOf, the parameter is mandatory.
Evaluates whether the given change query expression matches the change.

post.description: Marks the change as ready for review (set WIP property to false). Changes may only be marked ready by the owner, project owners or site administrators.

Rebases an ancestry chain of changes.

Reverts a change.
Creates open revert changes for all of the changes of a certain submission.

post.description: Deletes a reviewer from a change. Deleting a reviewer also removes that user from the attention set.
